completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository has an active Conductor no-stub completion rule, phase-boundary stub detector execution, archive policy evidence requirements, and an explicit delegated gap for detector expansion and backlog burn-down. It does not claim that every scaffold, placeholder, or backlog item has already been remediated.

implemented: phase checkpoint requirement to run the stub detector
archive policy requiring implementation and validation evidence
explicit delegation of detector expansion and backlog burn-down
not_implemented: claiming every scaffold/backlog item has been remediated
treating docs-only or placeholder artifacts as completion evidence

gap_register.rationale: This archive closes the governance enforcement contract; ongoing detector expansion belongs to the dedicated backlog track.

description: Prevent agents from marking tracks complete when they only created stubs, fakes, scaffolds, TODOs, or docs-only placeholders.
